ui_bugs.issue: Button renders with background 'none'/transparent and white text -> 'Download Brochure' label essentially invisible in modal (desktop & mobile). RCA: .fr-cta uses var(--fr-red)/var(--fr-red2) which are defined only on .fr-page; Radix Dialog portals DialogContent to document.body outside .fr-page so the CSS vars are undefined and the gradient is invalid. Fix: define the --fr-* vars on :root (or add className 'fr-page'-scoped vars to DialogContent, or use literal colors in .fr-cta).
